activity.notes: The Democratic Republic of the Congo was officially renamed the Republic of Zaire on 27 October 1971 while Mobutu remained president. He relinquished effective power and fled Kinshasa on 16 May 1997 as his regime collapsed. ATLAS splits the same continuous personal rule at the constitutional state-name change so that Congo and Zaire remain distinct historical polity Activities.

sources.title: Zaire's Mobutu Cedes Power, Flees Capital
sources.citation_text: The Washington Post reported on 16 May 1997 that Mobutu fled Kinshasa and his government announced that he had relinquished power.
